Below is a list of selected publications (sorted by year) illustrating the type of work conducted by our team. See also our [ongoing projects](projects.qmd) and [software](software.qmd). We aim to make our work open beyond the paper itself, so where we can, each paper links to its code, its published peer reviews, its registered protocol and its preprint.

```{r open-research}
open_research <- yaml::read_yaml("_data/paper-open.yml")
```

```{r}
bibfile <- "_data/papers.bib"
```

::: {.publications-list}

```{r, results='asis'}
# Custom function to truncate author list (keep first 3 + last 3)
truncate_authors <- function(authors) {
  if (is.null(authors) || length(authors) == 0) return("Unknown")
  # Handle person objects from bibtex
  if (inherits(authors, "person")) {
    author_list <- format(authors, include = c("given", "family"))
  } else {
    authors <- as.character(authors)
    author_list <- trimws(strsplit(authors, " and ")[[1]])
  }
  n <- length(author_list)
  if (n > 7) {
    # Show first 3, ..., last 3
    first_three <- paste(author_list[1:3], collapse = ", ")
    last_three <- paste(author_list[(n-2):n], collapse = ", ")
    paste0(first_three, ", ..., ", last_three)
  } else {
    paste(author_list, collapse = ", ")
  }
}

bib <- bibtex::read.bib(bibfile) %>%
  purrr::keep(~ attr(.x, "bibtype") == "Article")

# Sort by year descending
years <- purrr::map_chr(bib, ~ as.character(.x$year %||% "0"))
bib <- bib[order(years, decreasing = TRUE)]

# A preprint whose published version is also listed is shown as a link on
# that version rather than as a paper of its own
preprint_of_listed <- purrr::map_chr(open_research, ~ .x$preprint %||% NA_character_) |>
  na.omit() |>
  sub(pattern = "^https?://(dx\\.)?doi\\.org/", replacement = "") |>
  tolower()
bib <- purrr::discard(bib, ~ tolower(.x$doi %||% "") %in% preprint_of_listed)

preprint_servers <- c("medRxiv", "bioRxiv", "arXiv", "OSF Preprints")

# The open research marks under each paper. A paper listed from a preprint
# server is itself the preprint.
open_links <- function(doi, journal) {
  o <- open_research[[tolower(doi)]] %||% list()
  link <- function(url, label) sprintf('<a class="pub-open" href="%s">%s</a>', url, label)
  preprint_url <- if (journal %in% preprint_servers) {
    paste0("https://doi.org/", doi)
  } else {
    o$preprint
  }
  marks <- c(
    if (!is.null(o$code)) link(o$code, "Code"),
    if (isTRUE(o$open_review)) link(paste0("https://doi.org/", doi), "Open peer review"),
    if (is.character(o$open_review)) link(o$open_review, "Open peer review"),
    if (!is.null(o$registered)) link(o$registered, "Registered protocol"),
    if (!is.null(preprint_url)) link(preprint_url, "Preprint")
  )
  if (length(marks) == 0) return("")
  sprintf('<div class="pub-open-row">%s</div>', paste(marks, collapse = ""))
}

# Render each publication
purrr::walk(bib, function(entry) {
  authors <- truncate_authors(entry$author)
  title <- as.character(entry$title %||% "Untitled")
  title <- gsub("[{}]", "", title)
  journal <- as.character(entry$journal %||% "")
  journal <- gsub("[{}]", "", journal)
  year <- as.character(entry$year %||% "")
  doi <- as.character(entry$doi %||% "")

  if (doi != "" && !is.na(doi)) {
    title_html <- sprintf('<a href="https://doi.org/%s">%s</a>', doi, title)
  } else {
    title_html <- title
  }

  cat(sprintf(
    '<div class="pub-item"><strong>%s</strong> (%s). %s. <em>%s</em>.%s</div>\n',
    authors, year, title_html, journal, open_links(doi, journal)
  ))
})
```
